title: Maps out of a simplex boundary represent the proper-face limit
statement:
Let $T:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sets}$ be a small simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and let $n\geq0$. Define $\Delta^n_r=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([r],[n])$ and let $\partial\Delta^n_r$ consist of the nonsurjective order-preserving maps $[r]\to[n]$, with operators given by precomposition. In particular $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$. Let $F_n(T)$ be the set of families $(x_\iota)$ with $x_\iota\in T_k$ for each proper injective order-preserving map $\iota:[k]\hookrightarrow[n]$, $k<n$, satisfying $T(\theta)x_\iota=x_{\iota\theta}$ whenever $\theta:[l]\hookrightarrow[k]$ is injective. The restriction map
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(\partial\Delta^n,T)\longrightarrow F_n(T),\qquad h\longmapsto(h_k(\iota))_\iota$$
is a bijection, natural in $T$. Equivalently these evaluations exhibit this Hom set as the limit in sets of the diagram with one copy of $T_k$ for each proper injection $\iota:[k]\hookrightarrow[n]$ and, for each injective order-preserving $\theta:[l]\hookrightarrow[k]$, the map $T(\theta)$ from the copy of $T_k$ indexed by $\iota$ to the copy of $T_l$ indexed by $\iota\theta$. Under this bijection, restriction of the map $\Delta^n\to T$ given by $z\in T_n$ corresponds to $(T(\iota)z)_\iota$. The case $n=0$ gives a singleton on each side, the empty-family limit.
